verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes Shatter House as the rendered brand identity for the master site and Ridgehaven location.
The client requires location websites to retain the shared structure while rendering location-specific branding and wording; the added attribute does not conflict with prior brand state.
The client specifies the rendered black, purple, and white palette, national-brand positioning, and consistent branding across location pages; no prior attribute becomes obsolete.
The client requires the newly supplied logo to be rendered with the Shatter House branding, adding a concrete approved brand asset without making an older key stale.
First concrete failure: after viewing the published mockup, the client reports that it does not use the required Shatter House logo and company identity.
